newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU confirms clears CLT/Bertelsmann's UFA merger.
newsitem.headline: EU confirms clears CLT/Bertelsmann's UFA merger.

text.p: The European Commission confirmed on Monday it had cleared the merger between Luxembourg-based broadcaster CLT, which is controllled by Audiofina, and Bertelsmann's television unit UFA.

It said in a statement the proposed venture would probably improve the position of CLT and UFA within the European Union but that it did not believe any competitive advantages would result in a dominant position.
